app_name: DU SOL Freshers 2026 Official Pass Portal
design_context: Marketing / Event Pass Sales & Booking Portal
visual_mood: High-energy festival aesthetics, dark immersive obsidian background with neon laser accents, crystal glassmorphism navigation, urgent date-based pricing countdowns, and seamless manual UPI payment proof upload.

typography.headings: Unbounded, display sans-serif, bold, tight letter spacing
typography.body: Inter or DM Sans, clean geometric sans-serif for readability

layouts.spacing_scale: Generous padding p-8 to p-12 for bento cards, py-20 for section separation

motion.transitions: Smooth staggered entrance, hover lift effects (-translate-y-2), glowing border tracing beams

accessibility.standards: WCAG AA contrast compliant, high-visibility interactive states, explicit hover text colors, aria-labels, and data-testid on all interactive elements

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a gorgeous, high-conversion, futuristic pass booking portal for DU SOL Freshers Party 2026.
Include 3 Pass Tiers (Silver Solo, Gold Squad / Couple, VIP All-Access Diamond) with date-based price increases and urgency countdown timers.
Provide interactive pass selection supporting Single and Couple pass options.
Implement an easy manual payment proof upload workflow with QR code UPI scanning instructions (GPay/PhonePe/Paytm UPI ID: dusol2026@oksbi).
Provide instant pass confirmation state with generated Pass ID QR ticket, WhatsApp organiser direct contact CTA (pre-filled message), and booking interest form for group registration.

Include full party details: Date (October 18, 2026), Timings (4:00 PM onwards), Venue (Kingdom Arena, North Campus Delhi), Star DJ (DJ Ravish & DJ Krypton), Unlimited Multi-cuisine Buffet, Premium Mocktails & Bar Counters.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for rigorous testing.
Add admin view / toggle to review submitted booking interests and manual payment proofs.
